description: Negative: amount_usd is a JSON number (0.005), not a string. Must reject under JCS RFC 8785 because numbers canonicalize differently across implementations.
expected_failure_reason: amount_usd must be a fixed-scale decimal string with exactly 6 fractional digits, got number

description: Negative: amount_usd has only 4 decimal digits ('0.0100'), not the required 6. Must reject.
expected_failure_reason: amount_usd must have exactly 6 fractional digits, got 4 in '0.0100'

expected_failure_reason: scope_binding asset mismatch: signed for USDC, presented ETH
